label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value rememberMeKey derives from java.util.Random.nextInt(), which is cryptographically weak and used for session tokens/cookies. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-FP — resolved sink value combines static strings ('Inga', 'has been remembered...') and server-generated cookie data (rememberMeKey from Random, not user input). Case TP driven by Alert 1's confirmed vulnerability.

evidence.note: java.util.Random used to generate rememberMeKey for session storage
Sink writes static user string and server-generated cookie values, not user input
